body_markdown:
NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Voya Financial, Inc. (NYSE: VOYA), today announced that Heather Lavallee, chief executive officer, and Mike Katz, chief financial officer, are scheduled to host a fireside chat at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference on Wednesday, August 12th at 12:30 p.m. ET.


The live webcast will be available to the public at[investors.voya.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.voya.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54584405&newsitemid=20260805216020&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.voya.com&index=1&md5=53046541057f3d40f197ad222f6b5a16) . A replay of the webcast will be available at the same location.


**About Voya Financial®**


Voya Financial, Inc. (NYSE: VOYA) is a leading retirement, employee benefits and investment management company. Voya’s services and solutions help clear the path to financial confidence and a more fulfilling life for individual, workplace and institutional clients, supporting more than 18 million customer relationships. Certified as a “Great Place to Work” by the Great Place to Work® Institute, Voya fosters a culture that values customer centricity, integrity, accountability, agility and inclusivity. Together with customers and partners, Voya employees fight for everyone's opportunity for a better financial future. For more information visit[voya.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.voya.com%2F&esheet=54584405&newsitemid=20260805216020&lan=en-US&anchor=voya.com&index=2&md5=d3e11d20362ae9827681c8ddbac9342f) and follow Voya Financial on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fvoya%2Fposts%2F%3FfeedView%3Dall&esheet=54584405&newsitemid=20260805216020&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=3&md5=0746bf740ba4d626da15d822e89fd654) ,[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FVoyaFinancial%2F&esheet=54584405&newsitemid=20260805216020&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=4&md5=90e714ddb42fd8f4ca5aab8272bcbdd0) and[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fvoya%2F&esheet=54584405&newsitemid=20260805216020&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=5&md5=06ba53f5e25db83a32192dabc14572ab) .
